content.short: Payments app for collecting card, bank and USDC payments with cash-out options.
content.description: Decaf is a self-custody payments app built to bring stablecoins to consumers and merchants in emerging markets, with a strong focus on Latin America. Through a simple wallet on Solana, users can hold and spend USDC, send money across borders, and cash out to local bank accounts, while businesses can accept card, bank, and USDC payments via a point-of-sale system that settles in stablecoins. Decaf hides blockchain complexity behind an easy interface aimed at onboarding unbanked and underbanked users who need fast, low-cost dollar payments. By combining consumer wallets with merchant acceptance and off-ramps, Decaf positions Solana-based stablecoins as everyday money for people underserved by traditional banking.
content.meta: Decaf is a self-custody app to send, spend, and accept USDC payments on Solana. Discover Decaf and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
